name: Cleaning Agents
source: Pathfinder Society Intro #2: United in Purpose
description: Solvents and detergents spray from the ceiling and run down the walls where they combine in dangerous ways.
disable: Engineering Lore (trained) or DC 20 Thievery (trained) to deactivate the control panel, or DC 21 Athletics or DC 21 Acrobatics to plug the spouts that release the chemicals; three successes are required to disable the trap.
reset: The trap deactivates after 1 minute and resets in 1 hour.
routine: (3 actions) The trap fills the room with a cloud of caustic vapor and deals (2d6+2) Acid Damage damage to all creatures in the area (Basic DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw).

generalAbilities.name: Decontamination Spray
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the room.

Effect The trap sprays cleaning chemicals at the triggering creature dealing (1d8+4) Acid Damage damage. The creature must attempt a DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save, and the trap then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Dazzled for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is Blind for 1 round.
